description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the QuickLaunchAPI in the OrangeHRM Dashboard API module. It contains test methods to verify the behavior of the API, specifically focusing on the 'getAll' method with various fixture setups, as well as tests for unimplemented methods like create, delete, and validation rules.

classes.name: QuickLaunchAPITest
